tools.name: list_devices
tools.description: List the devices assigned to an employee. Hardware tickets need a device_id from this list.

tools.name: create_ticket
tools.description:
Open a helpdesk ticket for an employee. Returns the new ticket with its ID.
Hardware tickets need the device_id of the affected device (see list_devices).

employee_id.description: The employee the ticket is for, like E1001.

category.description: hardware: a problem with a physical device (needs device_id). software: an application problem or software request on a user's machine. access: accounts, logins and permissions. network: VPN, Wi-Fi and connectivity. incident: an outage or failure of a shared or production service.

priority.description: P1 is the most urgent, P4 the least.

device_id.description: The affected device's ID from list_devices. Required for hardware tickets.
